grain: A row is a transfer as the Nashoba Valley Reginal Dispatch Committee’s minutes record it: sometimes one line to another, sometimes one total for a batch, sometimes only the vote. Totals add the amounts the minutes print; a transfer approved with no amount printed is counted and adds nothing. The fiscal year is the one the minutes state where they state one, otherwise the year the meeting fell in, marked as ours.

sources.label: Every row for every board, counted or not, with the reason and the evidence

counted.description: Accept the State 911 Proposal: NVRDD will answer and transfer 9-1-1 calls originating in Boxborough to the Boxborough Police Department for 60 days; referred to the Administration Board. (the minutes record the vote, not the lines)
counted.fy_basis: the fiscal year the meeting fell in (ours; the minutes do not say)
